statements.proposition: This change leaves the default (no --enable-cache) behaviour of fastn unchanged and makes no breaking changes.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Read from the diff, nothing was built or run. Several edits take effect without the flag: (1) `fastn build` incremental mode now collects and stores real render dependencies where it stored an empty list before, and processes documents and dependencies in sorted order; (2) cached_parse no longer writes the parse cache when the flag is off, where it used to; (3) the cache directory layout and path in get_cache_file changed for everyone; (4) two committed build-output fixtures (fbt-tests 15 and 19, index.html) were rewritten. The PR text itself says it fixes the incremental build system. Whether any of this is 'breaking' for users is not shown, but 'default behaviour unchanged' does not hold.
evidence: files list: fastn-core/src/commands/build.rs modified (+24 -8): `let dependencies = vec![]` replaced by dependencies_during_render, sort calls added
fastn-core/src/doc.rs diff: cache_it only called inside `if enable_cache`; before the change it ran on every parse
fastn-core/src/utils.rs diff: get_cache_file builds a new per-project cache path, replacing the old fastn.com/<cwd> one

statements.proposition: The change is disabled by default and has no impact on existing installations.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The caching feature is disabled by default (enable_cache: false in Config::read, flag --enable-cache). But 'no impact on existing installations' does not hold: the build-system dependency collection, deterministic sorting, parse-cache write removal and the new cache path in utils.rs apply with or without the flag. Read from the diff only, nothing was run.
